title: Goodbye, Quick-Step: 24 Years of Cobbles, Glory, and Swagger
content:
Quick-Step’s historic run as title sponsor ends. From Boonen’s cobbles to Remco’s Vuelta, here are the moments that built a cycling powerhouse.

Read the full article at Goodbye, Quick-Step: 24 Years of Cobbles, Glory, and Swagger on Velo.
author: ahood
